description: Static assertions for helix-cad-roundtrip — cross-phase orchestrator sequencing the two mirror CAD bridges (bridge OUT / ingest IN) across HELIX P1-P4 with a classification spine, a per-part geometry-source gate (AI-parametric vs human-drawn-externally), a human-CAD design-import flow, and a verify loop
test_input: orchestrate the CAD geometry round-trip for a UUV part across phase 1-2-3-4, including parts the AI cannot auto-generate that a designer draws externally and imports back

assertions.name: commands_both_bridges
assertions.check: skill commands both mirror bridges helix-cad-bridge (OUT) and helix-cad-ingest (IN)

assertions.name: thin_orchestrator_delegates
assertions.check: skill is a thin orchestrator that never parses DXF / writes code-CAD itself, always delegates
assertions.regex: NEVER does bridge work|never parses|delegate|NOT a P-phase block|thin commander|chỉ huy

assertions.name: three_flows
assertions.check: skill defines 4 flows: ingest-first, forward, design-import, verify

assertions.name: human_cad_external_import
assertions.check: skill has a Flow D where the AI cannot auto-generate geometry, a human designer draws externally in a real CAD app and the drawing is imported back and reconciled
assertions.regex: Design-import|design-import|người (thiết kế )?vẽ|drawn EXTERNAL|external.*designer|Human-CAD|vẽ ngoài|Design Brief|reconcile vs Brief

assertions.name: geometry_source_gate
assertions.check: skill has a per-part Geometry Source Gate routing AI-parametric (Flow B) vs human-CAD (Flow D), defaulting to human when unsure
assertions.regex: Geometry Source Gate|nguồn hình học|AI-parametric.*Human-CAD|tham số.*phức tạp|mặc định.*D|default.*D

assertions.name: p1_p2_p3_p4_mapping
assertions.check: skill maps flows across HELIX Phase 1-2-3-4 blocks

assertions.name: classification_spine
assertions.check: skill reads (not sets) the classification label from p1-validate and enforces egress guard for MẬT

assertions.name: spatial_blindness_gate
assertions.check: skill preserves the LLM Spatial Blindness gate — CEO certifies, AI never self-certifies geometry

assertions.name: export_drift_verify_loop
assertions.check: skill closes the round-trip with a verify loop using dwg_dxf_diff.py and treats drift as directional

assertions.name: mirror_handoff_contract
assertions.check: skill threads only the mirror interfaces STEP (out) and cad_extract.json (in), and rev-locks handoffs in ICD

assertions.name: fabrication_handoff
assertions.check: skill routes to forge-fabrication (STEP F0-F5 and extract -> TCVN Quy trinh cong nghe)

assertions.name: smart_flow_router
assertions.check: skill provides a smart router that asks lifecycle position when no flag is given
assertions.regex: smart router|no flag|đang ở đâu|lifecycle|propose a flow|đề xuất flow
